title: How it works
content:
How it works

Pagefeather is a framework. Your Cloudflare account runs the site. The code lives in the public repository. You keep the tokens, the data, and the bill.

b-dosql: built-in database

PHP and its SQLite database run in one Durable Object. One command deploys a site to workers.dev. A hostname in a zone you own is also supported. On our own zones, zone attach needs a change request.

  • Deploy with deploy/deploy.sh and VARIANT=b-dosql.
  • Runs on Workers Free or Workers Paid.
  • On Free: plain WordPress and a light storefront. Editing a WooCommerce store needs Paid (#638).
  • MEDIA=1 puts uploads in R2. Pass MEDIA=1 on every later deploy of a site that has media.
  • One Durable Object holds the site: one writer, one region.

Uncached work is about 5 requests a second. Past that the queue grows. At about 100 clients the object refuses. Evidence: docs/perf-dosql.md.

Approach A: MySQL through Hyperdrive

PHP runs in a Worker. MySQL sits outside Cloudflare. Hyperdrive holds the connection pool. Placement should match the database region (#1054).

  • Deploy with VARIANT=a. Use MYSQL=external or MYSQL=vultr.
  • Workers Paid required. On Free the installer stops at the CPU limit.
  • You also pay for the MySQL server. A MYSQL=vultr box is $10 a month (cost.md).
  • Isolates scale out under concurrency. At 50 concurrent users, Cloudflare started up to 118 isolates (results.md, 2026-11-09).

Workers for Platforms

One platform Worker serves many sites. Each site is a named user Worker plus its own storage. deploy/wfp/site is the one operator surface (#294).

  • Workers for Platforms Paid plus Workers Paid: $30 a month at rest for two or more sites.
  • site add and site remove were measured from a clean checkout of main (results.md, 2026-11-24).
  • Operator flow: docs/guide/operator.md.

Page cache

When a visitor is logged out, a guest page can come from the Workers Cache and never reach PHP. Cart, checkout, account, and logged-in pages always run PHP.

  • Default guest TTL is 120 s (PAGE_CACHE_TTL).
  • Product, shop, and category pages default to 30 s (PAGE_CACHE_PRODUCT_TTL) since #628.
  • A cached product page can show an old stock number for a short window. Checkout always reads real stock (#628).

What you keep

  • Your Cloudflare account and your tokens
  • Your MySQL server, if you use approach A
  • Your media in R2 when MEDIA=1
  • Your deploy scripts and recorded inputs in the clone
